race.comment: TREBILCO (8) is part of a team of horses sent across the border from the Hawkes stable in Victoria, and that alone makes him hard to beat. This gelding will be fit after a couple of solid jump-outs under his belt, and is sure to be well-found in the markets. MORE THAN HOPE (3) was good enough to be stakes placed last season as a 3YO, and resumes from a spell that would have done him the world of good. Rochelle Milnes is up, and this gelding is ready to run a big race fresh. VIRTUAL ILLUSION (2) ran on nicely fresh up here 2 weeks ago over 1050m, and the extra 150m from a superior gate, makes him among the hardest to beat in this. MOSTLY FOR SHOW (1) will be peaking third up, and with the aid of a 3kg claim, he is expected to be very competitive. Each way.
